name: JZ-IV-10
summary: JZ-IV-10 is a piperidine derivative related to cocaine which acts as a highly potent serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (also called SNDRI, or triple reuptake inhibitor). The eugeroic modafinil was used as a lead to fuel this compound's discovery.
